description: This is a Java test class for the MessagesRoute component, testing various HTTP request scenarios related to messaging in the Eclipse Ditto gateway service.

classes.name: MessagesRouteTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the MessagesRoute endpoints, ensuring correct HTTP status codes for various messaging operations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before each test, setting up route testing with mocked routes.

methods.name: postThingsClaimMessage
methods.description: Tests posting a claim message to a 'things' inbox route.

methods.name: putThingsClaimMessageReturnsMethodNotAllowed
methods.description: Verifies that PUT method is not allowed on the claim message endpoint.

methods.name: postThingsClaimMessageWithTimeout
methods.description: Tests posting a claim message with a timeout parameter.

methods.name: postThingsInboxMessage
methods.description: Tests posting an inbox message for 'things'.

methods.name: postThingsInboxMessageWithSlashesInSubject
methods.description: Tests posting an inbox message with slashes in the subject for 'things'.

methods.name: putThingsInboxMessageReturnsMethodNotAllowed
methods.description: Verifies that PUT is not supported on inbox message post endpoint.

methods.name: postThingsOutboxMessage
methods.description: Tests posting an outbox message for 'things'.

methods.name: postThingsOutboxMessageWithSlashesInSubject
methods.description: Tests posting an outbox message with slashes in the subject.

methods.name: putThingsOutboxMessageReturnsMethodNotAllowed
methods.description: Checks that PUT is not allowed on outbox message endpoint.

methods.name: getNonExistingThingsMessagesUrl
methods.description: Ensures that accessing a non-existent URL returns 404 Not Found for 'things' messages.

methods.name: postFeaturesInboxMessage
methods.description: Tests posting an inbox message for 'features'.

methods.name: postFeaturesInboxMessageWithSlashesInSubject
methods.description: Tests posting an inbox message with slashes in the subject for 'features'.

methods.name: putFeaturesInboxMessageReturnsMethodNotAllowed
methods.description: Verifies that PUT is not allowed on 'features' inbox message endpoint.

methods.name: postFeaturesOutboxMessage
methods.description: Tests posting an outbox message for 'features'.

methods.name: postFeaturesOutboxMessageWithSlashesInSubject
methods.description: Tests posting an outbox message with slashes in the subject for 'features'.

methods.name: putFeaturesOutboxMessageReturnsMethodNotAllowed
methods.description: Checks that PUT is not supported on 'features' outbox message endpoint.

methods.name: getNonExistingFeaturesMessagesUrl
methods.description: Verifies that non-existent 'features' messages URL returns 404.

methods.name: postToWrongMessagesUrlWithMessagesSuffix
methods.description: Ensures that posting to an invalid Messages URL suffix returns 404.
